messages:
mira: Quick question — incoming Sr Infra IC (Berlin) accepted verbal. Local comp band is below what we offered. Need exception to bump base by €15k and split a €10k sign-on (50/50 over 6mo). Candidate's notice means start 2026-10-02 but they asked benefits effective 2026-10-01. Can we route this for approval and confirm benefits/start handling?
ellie: Thx Mira. Can you paste the proposed numbers and the candidate's current band? Also need the hiring rubric justification for above-band. Is relocation needed? :thinking_face:
mira: Sure — relocation assistance yes. Proposed: ```Base: €150,000 (band midpoint €135,000) Sign-on: €10,000 (split 50/50) Relocation stipend: €8,000 Total first-year comp: ~€168k``` Hiring rationale: senior infra experience + critical for infra reliability roadmap; replacing two roles worth of output.
darren: +1 from eng. This hire is on the critical path for Q4 infra rollout. We support exception.
jason: Finance — we'll need a short uplift memo and GL code for sign-on and relocation. Also confirm if OTE/bonus changes. Any reason this can't be structured as provisional uplift (6mo review) instead of permanent band change?
mira: Bonus stays standard (10%). OK with provisional uplift. I'll draft a 6mo performance-linked memo.
ellie: Routing: I'll open an exception request to the comp-committee and tag finance & hiring manager. Quick checklist: 1) candidate band comparison (local market comp link) 2) short hiring rationale + org impact 3) proposed payout schedule for sign-on 4) start/benefits plan. Can you drop those in?
mira: Dropping links and doc in #recruiting-pack shortly. One wrinkle on benefits — payroll cutoff means Oct 1 is needed for benefits enrollment. Can we front-load benefits a day?
jason: We can make benefits effective 10/01 if payroll has the onboarding packet before the cutoff. People-ops needs to mark them as preboarded with provisional payroll tag.
ellie: Action plan: - I'll route exception form to comp-committee with provisional uplift, tag @jason for GL sign-off. - People-ops will set benefits effective 2026-10-01 if onboarding packet submitted by 2026-09-28. - Sign-on split: 50% first paycheck, 50% after 6mo review. - Relocation paid as reimbursement on receipt of invoices.
mira: Sounds good. I'll aim to have docs & candidate acceptance email in by EOD. Thanks all. :pray:
people-ops-bot: New exception request created: EXC-2026-889. Comp-committee reviewers: @ellie, @jason, @sasha. Please review within 48h.
jason: I'll review GL and confirm by tomorrow morning.
ellie: tagging @mira once comp-committee decision arrives we'll update the offer letter with revised pay effective date and sign-on schedule.
mira: Appreciate it. Closing loop here once comp-committee responds.
